review_description: The electrician found a fault with the power board and fixed it on the spot. The installers worked hard, knew exactly what to do and the paperwork was not a fuss. The installers had a good sense of humour too.

We decided to go with gogreen (solarpv, Australian Company)  as the assessor was so helpuflul and supportive, and explained everythng incredibly well. Our quote ended up being a little more expensive than some other companies  however it feels fantastic to be supporitng a smaller passionate australian company whose product is excellent. I was totally blown away by their professionalism, and the 3 guys who installed the inverter and did the wiring were brillliant. it was a very difficult job with regard to access, and being 2 storye's , and took them a lot longer than most average semi detached homes, but they refused to take any shortcuts and did a superb job. From the time of our quote to installation it was only about 3 weeks.. All the questions on your site Finn that you suggest to ask, such as warranties, workmanship and basically every other consideration, they provided.
Having an all inclusive fixed price was key to my decision
